scheme_name: Chief Minister's Overseas Scholarship Scheme for Minorities
other_conditions: Applicant must belong to a minority community
Only one child of a family is eligible (self‑certification required)
Only one award per lifetime; the scheme cannot be availed again
Applicant must have valid TOEFL/IELTS and GRE/GMAT scores
Admission must be secured in an accredited foreign university
Applicant must possess a valid passport
Candidate must join the university within one year of selection notification
Candidate must not change the sanctioned course of study or research
Candidate is responsible for obtaining the appropriate visa for the study destination
benefits_summary: Grants up to ₹10  lakh in two installments (subject to actual fees), living‑expense assistance, eligibility for educational loans, opportunity for research/teaching assistantships, and a one‑way airfare ticket.
documents_required: Admission letter from accredited foreign university
Self‑certification confirming only one child eligibility
